# Purgatory (p7y)

> Self-hosted sandboxes for your team and their AI agents

Purgatory (p7y) gives each user of a team their own Docker daemon on demand: a sandbox with Portainer, a public URL for every app, sleep when idle and wake on the next request, archive on delete. A REST API and an MCP server (at /mcp) let coding agents create, wake and deploy to sandboxes.

## Getting started
